brief:
Pilot card · Mardu (WBR) · Tier 2 · All proxy · for Colby
 The Music Never Stopped
 What you give away comes back.
 ALESHA, WHO SMILES AT DEATH · Human Warrior W B R 
 First strike 
Whenever Alesha attacks , you may pay {W/B}{W/B} . If you do, return target creature card with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking .
 Printed: Bertha, Who Smiles at Death . {W/B} = pay W or B. The returned creature's enters trigger fires.
 3/2 
 Your turn, every turn
 1
 Cheap bodies
 Turn 1–2: Earth Mother, Lot Tarot Reader, Poster Artist, Wharf Rat, Friend of the Devil .
 2
 Bertha on 3
 Cast Bertha . Keep {W/B}{W/B} for her attack from turn 4.
 3
 Attack: bring one back
 Bertha returns a power-2 creature: Man in the Grey Suit (kill), Speedway Security (2 damage), Tour Manager (tutor).
 4
 Clamp the small ones
 Skull and Roses on a 1/1: it dies, you draw 2.
 5
 Sac for value
 Creature about to die anyway? Sacrifice it first: Lot Tarot Reader, Fire on the Mountain . Each death drains.
 Before the game
 Mulligan
 Bertha on turn 3 + a cheap creature.
 Draw 7. Keep: 3–4 lands with two colours, or 2 lands + a rock (Lightning Ring, Bandana, a patch) + a 1–2 drop. Ship: 0–1 lands; one colour only; 6+ lands.
 Say it
 "All proxies: big name is the story, real card in the credit line." Count death triggers out loud.
 At this table
 Harry
 Can't Touch This Drannith stops Calico's graveyard casts. Kill him (1/3): Thirteen-Point Bolt , Flowers in the Rifle . 
 Dylan
 K'rrik Bond + Blood drain loop. Brown Acid , The Wave Breaks or Center Was Not Holding on either. 
 Brandon
 artifacts · Crypt Exiles graveyards: Bertha and Calico lose their targets. Drain with what's on the board; Free Store his best artifact. 
 When this happens → do this 
 YOUR TURN 
 Picking Bertha's target Removal first ( Grey Suit, Speedway Security ), then a drainer, then Tour Manager or Roadie for a tutor. 
 Calico in play Once a turn: cast a permanent with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard: Skull and Roses , Tarot Reader, Poster Artist. 
 Behind on board Altamont with drainers out: every creature that dies drains, theirs too for the Poster Artist . 
 Friend of the Devil Every upkeep you lose life equal to the revealed card's mana value. Sacrifice him when life gets short. 
 Miracle at Dawn Reveal it as the first card you draw in a turn: miracle cost {X}{W}{W}. Otherwise it costs {X}{X}{W}{W}{W}. 
 THEIR TURN 
 Wipe on the stack The Spinner (sacrifice: indestructible), Peace Sign , or The Band Sat This One Out . 
 Removal at Bertha The Earth Mother : protection from that colour. Riding Leathers : shroud. 
 ANY TIME 
 Your creature is targeted Sacrifice it in response: you still get the drain, and their spell fizzles. 
 Going off? 
 - Two drainers : Wharf Rat, Poster Artist, Second-Line Mourner, In Memoriam 
- A free sac outlet: Lot Tarot Reader, Fire on the Mountain, Basement Lab 
- Fodder: Goblins from Chapter President, Road Captain, Merry Pranksters ; Dancing Bones 
- Rosie doubles every death trigger 
 Rosie + Wharf Rat + Second-Line Mourner : each creature of yours that dies = 4 to each opponent . Ten deaths = 40. Skull and Roses with Rosie draws 4 per death.
 No drainers?
 Miracle at Dawn : X 4/4 flying Angels. Peace Sign : 4 to a player, or double strike. Fire on the Mountain : 1 damage per creature sacrificed.
 Once it lands
 Drainers and Rosie are what they kill. Hold The Spinner or Peace Sign , then sac the board.
